mentions.name: Weblock Browser
mentions.description: An iOS restricted browser for kids with strong parental controls. It classifies websites with AI to determine whether a site is safe for a child to visit, using domain content categories from the Cloudflare Intel API as context; if AI disallows a website, the child can ask a parent to allow it.
mentions.source_excerpt:
I work on my iOS app - Weblock Browser, a restricted browser for kids with strong parental controls: https://weblock.online
Recently I've added AI classification of websites to determine if a website is safe for a child to visit. If AI disallows a website, you can ask your parent to allow it.

mentions.name: Weblock
mentions.description: A restricted, whitelist-only browser for kids on iOS that lets children open only parent-approved websites. When a child wants to visit an unknown website, the parent receives a notification and can allow or deny the request.
mentions.problem: Children can otherwise open any website on a device; parents need a way to restrict kids to only approved websites.
mentions.audience: Parents who want to restrict their children's web browsing to approved websites.
mentions.source_excerpt:
Just launched a restricted browser for kids for iOS: https://weblock.online
Now testing on my kids. The idea is that the browser is whitelist-only, so kids can open only approved websites. I receive a notification when they want to visit an unknown website and I can allow or deny it.
